items.description: Sitting black pug figurine with the white chest blaze, wrinkled face and large sculpted eyes. Desk ornament in black PLA+ with a white chest accent; the matching chunky head keyring is sold separately. Made to order in Leicester.
items.material: SUNLU PLA+ black with white chest accent (IFS)
items.material_note: PLA is a plant-based plastic. It is brittle and can snap if dropped hard or bent, softens above about 50-60 C (do not leave it in a hot car or on a radiator), and is not food-safe as printed.
